args.prompt:
Your only job is to edit the file b.ts in the current working directory using the edit tool, changing the value of B from 1 to 2.

Steps:
1. Read b.ts to see its exact contents.
2. Use the edit tool to change B from 1 to 2 (exact string replacement).
3. Report back what you changed.

Do not edit any other file. Do not create files.
